Perfect! My fix resolved the state leakage issue. Let me show the final results:

**Git diff (machtzev/ only):**
```
 machtzev/generator/app-ds.mjs | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
```

The single line change I made:
- Added `setLook('dark');` at the start of `buildApp()` function to reset the global LOOK variable to its default state for each build, preventing state leakage from previous builds when `buildApp()` is called multiple times in the same process.

**Machine VERDICT:**
```
## VERDICT: **DONE**

All checks passed:
✅ regen_ok — App regenerated successfully with new stages field on אדם entity
✅ byte_identical_others — No other apps modified; only panuy.txt spec changed
✅ no_orphans — No orphaned generated files
✅ gates_pass — All validation gates passed
✅ no_hebrew_in_engine — No Hebrew literals in engine code
✅ dart_math_sane — No unsafe dart:math methods
✅ compiles — Generated Dart passes flutter analyze with zero errors
✅ s1 — Field סטטוס stages properly defined: פנוי, הוזמן, בוצע
✅ s2 — Particle and dashboard counter updated correctly
```

The fix ensures that when `buildApp()` is called multiple times (either in the same process by test utilities importing from app-ds.mjs, or across different processes), each invocation starts with a clean slate by resetting the LOOK variable. This prevents the state leakage that was affecting the sechirut app generation when panuy was added to the system.
